title: FLIRT: Feedback Loop In-context Red Teaming
findings: The paper's proposed FLIRT framework, particularly the scoring-based strategies, significantly outperformed the Stochastic Few Shot (SFS) baseline at prompting a text-to-text model (GPT-Neo) to generate toxic responses. This was demonstrated in an experiment where the seed prompts explicitly targeted religious groups (Jews, Christians, and Muslims) to trigger hateful content generation.
